sections.title: Headroom after reserve
sections.sql: SELECT code,allocated_cpu,cpu_headroom,allocated_memory_gib,memory_headroom_gib,inventory_state FROM capacity_review ORDER BY code
sections.note: Allocatable CPU units, not physical core counts. Negative headroom is above policy allocation.

sections.title: Sizing evidence
sections.sql: SELECT code,cpu,suggested_cpu,memory_gib,suggested_memory_gib,data_state FROM workload_review ORDER BY code
sections.note: A sizing suggestion is a review candidate, never a performance guarantee.

sections.title: Decisions and outcomes
sections.sql: SELECT code,workload_code,due_on,status,overdue FROM change_review ORDER BY due_on

sections.title: Evidence gaps
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM compliance_review ORDER BY rule,record

sections.title: Open actions
sections.sql: SELECT code,name,owner,due_on FROM followups WHERE resolution IS NULL ORDER BY due_on
